set -euo pipefail
check_sha(){ pkg="$1" ver="$2" expected="$3"; got="$(apt-cache show "$pkg=$ver" | awk '/^SHA256:/{print $2; exit}')"; [ "$got" = "$expected" ]; }
check_sha zbar-tools 0.23.93-4build3 9e718d34a9650263aca2dd85e56d9de42ca24ff82254f90f5e4270d1e5d00422
check_sha qrencode 4.1.1-1build2 613c5a22316489ec6a9ce5d59190293df15dd4612b55432dde04c62f7c1a0e25
check_sha zint 2.13.0-1build3 cdd7a7379dae12c3effdb5f3d55c89077003b72772bcf543f7139146f272b769
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends zbar-tools=0.23.93-4build3 qrencode=4.1.1-1build2 zint=2.13.0-1build3 >/dev/null
qrencode -o canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/ZBAR_VERIFY_QR.png 'PROJECT BRAIN'
zint -b CODE128 -o canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/ZBAR_VERIFY_BARCODE.png -d 'PROJECT BRAIN'
qr="$(zbarimg --quiet --raw canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/ZBAR_VERIFY_QR.png)"
bar="$(zbarimg --quiet --raw canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/ZBAR_VERIFY_BARCODE.png)"
[ "$qr" = 'PROJECT BRAIN' ]
[ "$bar" = 'PROJECT BRAIN' ]
printf 'ZBAR_MULTIFORMAT_VERIFIED\n'
